description: Renovate proposes every dependency update (it replaced Dependabot's version updates). docs/dependencies.md describes what it reads and when. This file is plain JSON, with no comments, because scripts/check_watches.py reads it with Python's json module; each rule says why in its `description`.
Images that no other manager reads: the ones `docker run` starts in workflow steps (actionlint, gitleaks in ci.yml; Trivy in scan.yml).

The engines' tags in diun/images.yml (`- name: docker.io/library/<engine>:<tag>`). Same depName, datasource and currentValue as compose.yaml's pin, so one version bump is one branch and changes both files (scripts/check_watches.py fails CI if they disagree). Diun's entries carry no digest, so a rebuild changes only compose.yaml.

An image rebuild (a new digest under the same tag) doesn't wait: Docker Hub dates it by the tag's last push, so a tag rebuilt about weekly would restart the clock each time and never get through the Monday-only schedule.
init, analyze and upload-sarif must share one version (was Dependabot's `codeql` group).
The smoke test's `runs-on: ubuntu-24.04` (ci.yml) matches the server's Ubuntu release: it moves with the server, by hand.
The repo's Python is 3.14 (pyproject.toml's target-version, the setup-python steps, the GitLab job image): a new patch release is fine, a new minor moves by hand together with those.
Only the idle workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml uses this action; its pin stays as it is until the workflow is deleted.
diun/images.yml keeps its tags unpinned (Diun compares the tag, not a digest), so Renovate must not add a digest there; it only moves the tag together with compose.yaml.
A new major version (or MariaDB series) of an engine needs a planned upgrade (docs/upgrading.md): Renovate opens a pull request only once the owner ticks it on the Dependency Dashboard.

The database engines (owner 2026-11-20): Renovate proposes their versions and rebuilds, and never merges them. The owner merges at a quiet time (docs/upgrading.md): a new engine version, even a patch, restarts every app's database. Keep this the LAST rule that mentions them; scripts/check_watches.py fails CI if an engine could auto-merge.
prBodyNotes: **Database engine: Renovate never merges this.** Merge it by hand at a quiet time, after the steps in docs/upgrading.md.
